status: FINAL APPLICATION for the maintainer: P1 (teacher generation) + P1v (its $0 verification, corpus build and B's real pack) ONLY -- 2026-10-22 UTC, after the comparator, completion-persistence and launch-wiring corrections. AUTHORIZES NOTHING: no grant is issued, no cap is raised, no resource is created by this file. The whole H1 package, P1g, P2 and the network volume are NOT requested.
scope: generate the teacher candidates of arm B's generated cells (plans/generation_plan.json) on one A100-80GB session, bring every record home, then verify, select and pack on the dev box at $0. Nothing is trained, evaluated or stored on paid storage.

generation_list.what: per (stratum, source) cell of stage2.reasoning_master@v1: the tasks drawn (round-robin over generator x difficulty / module x level, in pool order, never by a result), the cell's units, the named rate basis, expected units and the generated-token upper bound; the run_battery inputs and their sha256
generation_list.only_verifiable: every task has a usable project verifier (generation_plan.verifier_of): comparators, checkers.CHECKERS, supporting_verify.VERIFIERS, the battery scorer or environment replay
generation_list.inputs_location: artifacts/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/generation_inputs/ (dev box, gitignored; sha256 in the plan; rebuilt byte-identically by generation_plan from the committed pools)

scale: plans/generation_plan.json :: totals (tasks, episodes, predicted_generated_tokens) and cells. predicted_generated_tokens is a PREDICTION from mean tokens per candidate and planned acceptance, NOT an execution limit: the session's hard bound is the authorized cap, enforced by the watchdog
acceptance_basis: plans/generation_plan.json :: cells[].rate_basis: measured on the same generators where the teacher has run (Stage-0 teacher_cal, re-counted at the 8,184 allowance), otherwise a NAMED PROXY (the same axis on teacher_cal; corpus_v2's nearest type) or the spec's labelled code assumption (0.4), with a larger margin for proxied cells. Known optimistic proxies: PrOntoQA's process gate and the answerability rate (borrowed from answerable rag questions) are not measured The two-candidate yield q = 1-(1-p)^2 is a simplifying planning assumption (a retry of a hard task is not independent of its failure) and guarantees no cell's supervised tokens.

resources.gpu: 1 x A100-80GB, one session, at most one billing resource (teacher_cal's measured GPU, engine and price: plans/cost_forecast.json :: measured.teacher_generation)
resources.engine: vLLM 0.27.1 image as teacher_cal; run_battery --mode generate under scripts/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/generation_driver.py
resources.hours: plans/cost_forecast.json :: generation (gpu_hours at the measured tokens/s; session_hours_with_contingency)
resources.no_model_code_on_the_pod: the pod generates text only; code candidates are executed afterwards in the probed dev-box sandbox

failure_and_teardown_reserve.behaviour: generation_driver: run_battery streams every finished episode (--stream-completed); the driver seals finished candidates into hash-marked shards every 100 records or 300 s, and the launcher pulls every marked shard on each poll and hash-checks it into <scr>/store, so finished work leaves the pod before its group ends. A restart (or a replacement session given --resume-store) re-verifies the sealed shards and generates only the candidates without a record, under the same seed. RUN_FAILED keeps every shard; ALL_DONE needs every group complete. Teardown, the provider's confirmation and a fresh reconciliation are the launcher's (h1_generation_launch.closeout)

persistence.summary: EXISTING storage: sealed shards are pulled to the dev box on every poll and hash-checked (launcher on_poll), the run's closeout re-hashes all of them; the records are about 0.1 GB per copy. A second copy on the relay is made from the dev box at P1v (capacity probed 2026-10-22T15:53Z: 2 x 150 MB, 1 GB, 2 GB accepted) and read back. No network volume for P1; the 30 GB volume is the preferred TRAINING backend, a separate authorization

budget_occupancy.rule: CONSERVATIVE OCCUPANCY: the provider's all-time billing counted ONCE (no record total added on top, so nothing is double-counted; no unknown cost written off). The 34 unnamed pods ($58.33) and the anchor's meaning stay OPEN; this rule asserts neither
budget_occupancy.requested_project_cap: provider all-time billing at the pre-launch snapshot + P1's hard cap (plans/cost_forecast.json p1_application.totals.hard_cap_usd). With the 2026-10-21 snapshot ($658.15) and today's hard cap ($8.02) that is $666.17, against today's cap $643.6571: a value the maintainer may approve, NOT applied by this file. If the pre-launch snapshot differs, the requested cap moves by exactly that difference
budget_occupancy.before_create: a fresh provider snapshot and reconciliation (0 pods, 0 volumes, $0/h) and the same-failure gate, as every paid session

frozen_in_the_protocol.mbpp_single_candidate: configs/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/generation_protocol.json :: execution.no_second_candidate_verifiers (code_asserts): MBPP gets ONE candidate; a short code cell is reported, never topped up by an automatic new paid session
frozen_in_the_protocol.execution_values: generation_protocol.json :: execution (action protocol v2, session limit 8,184, seed base, completion shards); the driver reads them only after the launch identity binds the file
frozen_in_the_protocol.completion_rule: generation_protocol.json :: completion_rule: ALL_DONE only when every task of every pass has exactly one record; finished results are preserved within the cost bound; a short corpus is never completed by repetition, a lower correctness gate, another source or another mix
